content:
## Overview
Linkivo is Turzo's most sophisticated active project — a Smart Link Management PWA built purely with Vanilla JavaScript, Firebase, and GSAP animations. No frameworks, no shortcuts.

## Technical Highlights
- Custom SPA architecture with event-driven client-side routing
- GSAP cinematic splash screen: link cards converge into an auto-locking padlock
- Firebase RTDB for real-time persistence across sessions
- PIN-lock security using HTML `inert` attribute + `visibility:hidden` for DOM hiding
- Weighted discovery algorithm surfaces links based on assigned point values

## Multi-layer Website Preview
The preview system falls through multiple fallback layers: iframe embed → Open Graph thumbnail → Screenshot API → Favicon extraction. This ensures some form of visual preview for virtually any URL.

content:
## Overview
Project Exporter Pro is an open-source, zero-dependency JavaScript export engine that adds multi-format export capability to any web application without any style conflicts.

## Shadow DOM Isolation
The entire widget lives inside a Shadow DOM boundary. Host page styles cannot leak in; widget styles cannot leak out. True encapsulation.

## Supported Formats
PNG · JPG · WebP · SVG · PDF · CMYK

## API
```js
ExporterPro.export({ format: 'png', quality: 0.95, element: document.querySelector('#target') })
```
Clean, intuitive, plug-and-play.

content:
## Overview
A drop-in notification widget powered entirely by Google Sheets — no server, no database setup needed. Embed it in any website in minutes.

## Architecture
```
Google Sheet (data source)
  → Apps Script JSON API endpoint
    → JavaScript fetch()
      → DOM rendering
        → LocalStorage (read/unread state persistence)
```

## Currently Used In
Live on **mdturzo.odoo.com** as the main portfolio notification system.

content:
## Overview
QR Prism is a full-featured Progressive Web App covering every aspect of QR code workflows: generation, scanning, batch processing, cloud management, and admin tools.

## Architecture Evolution
- **v2.7**: Canvas-based QR rendering
- **v3.4**: Migrated to SVG rendering for sharper, scalable output at any size

## Service Worker Strategy
Three-tier caching:
1. **Cache-First** — static assets (JS, CSS, icons)
2. **Network-First** — API calls for fresh data
3. **Stale-While-Revalidate** — HTML pages (instant load + background update)

## Admin Security
SHA-256 hash verification client-side + Firebase DB `admins/{uid}: true` server-side check. Prevents all client-side bypass attempts.
